getting_started:
GETTING STARTED - LIVE IN 5 MINUTES (OpenRouter, free, no card):
1. Go to https://openrouter.ai and sign up (email or Google).
2. Click Keys -> Create Key -> copy it.
3. Open SimpleJack -> Model Hub -> paste the key into the OpenRouter key box.
4. Pick any card marked FREE (GLM 5.2 Free, Gemma 4 31B Free, more).
5. Type in the chat. You are live. Free cards need no credit card.
